text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at the family restaurant,
I could hear some rather boisterous voices—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's enough already, Ticket-san!
I said I was sorry~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Urk... No way...
I don't wanna give uuuup~~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to show off your guts here of all places!
Wait, s-seriously, geez...!!

On their table stood a colossal, multi-layered wall—
or rather, an enormous, half-eaten hamburger.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san... Is this—
*urgh*...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah! Shut your mouth!
I'll explain instead!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
They hold solo eating challenges here, see.
I'm the one who dared them to try it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totes, just kidding!
Guess I just forgot what Ticket-san is like, haha...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Upupu... Well, because
it looked like so much fun...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, yeah, I egged them on with the same logic,
but who knew it'd be this insane amount?!"
True, this far exceeds what anyone would normally picture for a competitive eating challenge...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I told them to just give up
and share it with us, but—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: There's no waaaay I'm ever giving up!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"The race is only halfway through!
From here on is where I show off my late-charging prowess!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So I definitely won't lo—*urgh*...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm telling you, the distance aptitude is totally wrong!
This is meant for someone on Oguri-san's level!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo-san's Trainer,
please back me up here~!
choice_data_list: Finish every last bite through sheer willpower!
Finish every last bite through sheer willpower!
If it's come to this, then by brute force...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo-san's Trainer,
please back me up here~!
choice_data_list: Finish every last bite through sheer willpower!
Finish every last bite through sheer willpower!
If it's come to this, then by brute force...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeahhhhh~!!
It really all comes down to willpower, doesn't it, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you scared me!
Talk about an instant recovery!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
With your cheers, Trainer,
victory is practically already ours!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Halfway done, let's charge for the goal~!
Doryaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geh! How is she eating
even faster now?!

The burger, once towering like a wall,
vanished in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaa... Incredible...
Doing all this on pure fighting spirit alone...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seeing something like this right in front of me...
is seriously getting me super hyped up!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, Ticket-san!
You've totally got this~~~~!!"
And—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Just! One more bite! Argh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Goooo for it--!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOO~~~~!!
VICTORY IS MIIIIINE!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I finally did id... I did id!
I won... against the giant hamburger!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo-san, congrats!
Why is this making me cry so much~~?!
And so, shedding tears of emotion, the two shared a tight embrace.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
What do you mean, brute force—
choice_data_list: I'm gonna crush you from above!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Aahh~, I get it now!
Trainer-san, that's a pro idea for sure!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What do you mean?!
Why are you crushing it~?!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You know how in movies and stuff, they sometimes squish their burgers before eating them?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you do that, it'll take up less space,
so isn't that advice on how to finish it all!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-I get it noooow!!
Trainer-san, you're an absolute genius!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Got it, I'll crush 'em!
All right, now that that's settled—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Jordaaan!!!!
Give me a piggyback ride!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Why?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"This burger is so tall
that my hands can't reach the top~~ C'mon, pleeease!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like, I seriously, completely hate that!?
After a series of twists and turns...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—*urp*...
S-somehow... I finished it all by myself...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Man, Ticket-san is crazy intense.
Can't believe she brute-forced her way through all that food.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, sauce went flying and buns almost slipped out
along the way, among other things."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I saw it through to the end.
I... understand now, after this challenge."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —They say brute force solves everything, right?! Yaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hasn't she turned into a completely different person?

Leaving Tosen Jordan's complaints aside,
Winning Ticket soaked in the sheer bliss of cleaning her plate.
